tagline: Compounds with trials behind them, at the doses used in those trials.
description: Creatine, caffeine, citrulline and beta-alanine have decades of evidence. Almost everything else sold alongside them does not. This category is graded hardest on dose: a clinically studied ingredient at a decorative amount scores zero on efficacy regardless of how clean the label is.

copy.unit_basis: Based on declared nutrition, per 5 g creatine.
copy.guide_heading: How do you like your performance?
copy.empty_title: Nothing here clears our bar yet.
copy.empty_body: We reviewed 371 performance products reaching Kuwait and published none. A shelf is whatever clears our listing floor, and nothing in this category does yet — we would rather show you an empty shelf than a padded one.

milk_allergy_empty.title: Nothing here is free of milk.
milk_allergy_empty.body: Every product published in this category declares milk, or has no dairy-free declaration we could read. We will not answer a declared milk allergy from silence.

director_selection.note: Products a founder put on the shelf from the database, whatever their score.

types.name: Creatine Monohydrate
types.purpose: The most studied performance supplement in existence. Also the easiest to overpay for.
non_negotiables: Monohydrate, not a patented form charging a premium for no added effect
Single ingredient — creatine and nothing else
Creapure or an equivalent published purity certificate

types.name: Pre-Workout
types.purpose: Stimulant and pump formulas. The category with the highest rejection rate we have.
non_negotiables: Zero proprietary blends — every dose disclosed in milligrams
Caffeine at or under 300 mg per serving
No DMAA, DMHA, yohimbine at stimulant doses, or synephrine stacks

types.name: EAA & BCAA
types.purpose: Free-form amino acids for training on an empty stomach.
non_negotiables: All nine essential amino acids, not just the three branched-chain

types.name: Beta-Alanine
types.purpose: Buffers the burn in efforts lasting one to four minutes.
non_negotiables: 3.2 g or more per daily dose

types.name: Citrulline & Nitric Oxide
types.purpose: Blood-flow support taken before training, without the stimulants.
non_negotiables: 6 g or more of L-citrulline, or 8 g of citrulline malate

strengths: Active delivered in the exact form the evidence used
Free of all 14 EU-declarable allergens, stated and tested
caveats: No cross-contact statement and the facility is not declared allergen-controlled
Brand has no identifiable legal entity, address or contactable quality function
